documents.title: Plaint
pages:
IN THE COURT OF THE IV CIVIL JUDGE, SENIOR DIVISION, INDORE (M.P.)
RCSA No. 214/2025
Ramesh Chandra Patidar S/o Shri Gopallal Patidar, aged about 52 years, Occupation: Agriculture, R/o Gram Navlakhi Kheda, Tehsil and District Indore (M.P.)  ....PLAINTIFF
VERSUS
1. Suresh Kumar Joshi S/o Shri Ramnarayan Joshi, aged about 47 years, Occupation: Business, R/o 23, Saraswati Vihar, Indore (M.P.)
2. Smt. Kamla Bai W/o Late Shri Mohanlal Yadav, aged about 68 years, R/o Gram Navlakhi Kheda, Tehsil and District Indore (M.P.)  ....DEFENDANTS
SUIT FOR PERMANENT AND MANDATORY INJUNCTION
The plaintiff above named respectfully submits as under:
1. That the plaintiff is the owner in possession of agricultural land bearing Khasra No. 87/2, area 0.405 hectare, situated at Gram Navlakhi Kheda, P.H. No. 21, Tehsil and District Indore (hereinafter called 'the suit land').
2. That the plaintiff purchased the suit land from defendant No. 2 Smt. Kamla Bai by a registered sale deed dated 14.06.2019 for a total consideration of Rs. 18,50,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Fifty Thousand only), and actual physical possession was handed over to the plaintiff on the same day.

3. That on the basis of the said sale deed the name of the plaintiff was mutated in the revenue records by order dated 22.08.2019 of the Tehsildar, Indore in mutation case No. 312/A-6/2019-20, and since then the plaintiff is recorded as bhumiswami in the khasra and B-1 entries. The plaintiff grows soybean and wheat on the suit land.
4. That defendant No. 1 owns the adjoining land Khasra No. 87/3 situated on the eastern side of the suit land.
5. That on 02.02.2025 defendant No. 1, with 4-5 labourers and a JCB machine, started digging a foundation for a boundary wall inside the suit land along its eastern side, thereby encroaching upon a strip of about 10 feet x 120 feet (about 1,200 sq. ft.) of the suit land. When the plaintiff objected, defendant No. 1 abused him and said that the wall would be raised in any case.
6. That the plaintiff lodged a written complaint at Police Chowki Navlakhi Kheda on 03.02.2025 and also sent a legal notice dated 05.02.2025 to defendant No. 1 through his counsel, but defendant No. 1 has not stopped the work.
7. That no demarcation of the suit land has ever been carried out in the presence of, or with notice to, the plaintiff. Defendant No. 2 is the vendor of the plaintiff and is impleaded only as a proforma party; no relief is claimed against her.

8. That the cause of action for the suit arose on 02.02.2025 when defendant No. 1 started the construction, again on 05.02.2025 when the notice was sent, and it is continuing, at Gram Navlakhi Kheda within the jurisdiction of this Hon'ble Court.
9. That the suit is valued at Rs. 1,50,000/- for the purposes of jurisdiction and court fee, and court fee of Rs. 8,250/- has been paid.
10. That no other suit on the same cause of action is pending in any court.
RELIEF: The plaintiff therefore prays that -
(a) a decree of permanent injunction be passed restraining defendant No. 1, his agents and labourers from raising any construction on, or interfering with the plaintiff's possession over, the suit land Khasra No. 87/2;
(b) a decree of mandatory injunction be passed directing defendant No. 1 to remove the foundation dug on the eastern portion of the suit land;
(c) costs of the suit be awarded to the plaintiff, and any other relief the Hon'ble Court deems fit.
Indore, dated 17.02.2025          Plaintiff, through counsel R.K. Tiwari, Advocate
VERIFICATION: I, Ramesh Chandra Patidar, verify that the contents of paras 1 to 10 above are true to my knowledge. Verified at Indore on 17.02.2025.

documents.title: Written statement of defendant No. 1
pages:
IN THE COURT OF THE IV CIVIL JUDGE, SENIOR DIVISION, INDORE
RCSA No. 214/2025
Ramesh Chandra Patidar ....Plaintiff  vs.  Suresh Kumar Joshi & Anr. ....Defendants
WRITTEN STATEMENT ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT No. 1
1. Para 1 of the plaint is denied as stated. It is admitted that the plaintiff has purchased Khasra No. 87/2, but it is denied that he is in possession of the entire 0.405 hectare. On the spot the plaintiff is in possession of only about 0.380 hectare.
2. Para 2 is a matter of record. Para 3 needs no reply.
3. Para 4 is admitted to the extent that the answering defendant is the owner in possession of Khasra No. 87/3, area 0.320 hectare, which he purchased from Shri Bherulal Patel by a registered sale deed dated 23.09.2011.
4. Para 5 is denied. The answering defendant has not encroached upon any part of the suit land. The strip on which the boundary wall is being raised is part of Khasra No. 87/3 and not of Khasra No. 87/2. It is also wrong that the work started on 02.02.2025; the foundation of the boundary wall was dug on 15.12.2024 and the plaintiff raised no objection till February 2025. No JCB machine was used.
5. Para 6: receipt of the notice dated 05.02.2025 is admitted, but its contents are denied.

6. Para 7 is denied.
ADDITIONAL PLEAS
7. That on the application of the answering defendant, the Revenue Inspector, Circle Navlakhi Kheda, carried out demarcation of Khasra Nos. 87/2 and 87/3 on 08.01.2025 in the presence of the halka Patwari and fixed stone marks on the common boundary. The plaintiff was informed but chose not to remain present. The boundary wall is being raised strictly on the line fixed in the demarcation, inside Khasra No. 87/3.
8. That the plaintiff has suppressed the demarcation and has not come to the court with clean hands.
9. That the suit is undervalued and proper court fee has not been paid.
10. That the answering defendant has already spent about Rs. 3,40,000/- on the foundation and material, and stopping the work will cause him irreparable loss.
PRAYER: It is prayed that the suit of the plaintiff be dismissed with special costs of Rs. 25,000/-.
Indore, dated 20.03.2025          Defendant No. 1, through counsel S.N. Mishra, Advocate
VERIFICATION: I, Suresh Kumar Joshi, verify that the contents of paras 1 to 10 are true to my knowledge. Verified at Indore on 20.03.2025.

documents.title: Order on temporary injunction application dated 11.04.2025
pages:
IN THE COURT OF THE IV CIVIL JUDGE, SENIOR DIVISION, INDORE
RCSA No. 214/2025    CNR No. TESTMPID010021412025
Ramesh Chandra Patidar vs. Suresh Kumar Joshi & Anr.
11.04.2025
Plaintiff with Shri R.K. Tiwari, Advocate.
Defendant No. 1 with Shri S.N. Mishra, Advocate.
None for defendant No. 2.
Heard on I.A. No. 1, the application of the plaintiff under Order 39 Rules 1 and 2 CPC, and the reply of defendant No. 1.
The plaintiff relies on a registered sale deed and revenue entries for Khasra No. 87/2. Defendant No. 1 claims that the disputed strip forms part of his Khasra No. 87/3 and relies on a demarcation, the report of which has not been filed. The exact position of the common boundary can be ascertained only on local inspection.
Therefore, till the disposal of I.A. No. 1, both parties shall maintain status quo regarding possession and construction over the eastern portion of Khasra No. 87/2. Defendant No. 1 shall not raise any further construction over the foundation already dug.
Shri Anil Chouhan, Advocate, is appointed as Commissioner. He shall inspect the site with the halka Patwari in the presence of both parties, prepare a panchnama and site map, and submit his report within 15 days. The Commissioner's fee of Rs. 5,000/- shall be paid by the plaintiff.
Defendant No. 1 is directed to file the demarcation report relied upon by him before the next date.
List on 02.05.2025 for the Commissioner's report and further hearing on I.A. No. 1.
Sd/- IV Civil Judge, Senior Division, Indore

विक्रय पत्र (प्रमाणित प्रतिलिपि का उद्धरण)
उप पंजीयक कार्यालय, इंदौर-2    पंजीयन क्रमांक 4471/2019    दिनांक 14.06.2019
यह विक्रय पत्र आज दिनांक 14.06.2019 को निम्न पक्षकारों के बीच निष्पादित किया गया:
विक्रेता: श्रीमती कमला बाई पत्नी स्व. श्री मोहनलाल यादव, उम्र 62 वर्ष, निवासी ग्राम नवलखी खेड़ा, तहसील व जिला इंदौर (म.प्र.)
क्रेता: श्री रमेशचंद्र पाटीदार पिता श्री गोपाललाल पाटीदार, उम्र 46 वर्ष, व्यवसाय कृषि, निवासी ग्राम नवलखी खेड़ा, तहसील व जिला इंदौर (म.प्र.)
विक्रेता के स्वामित्व व कब्ज़े की कृषि भूमि ग्राम नवलखी खेड़ा, प.ह.नं. 21, तहसील व जिला इंदौर में स्थित खसरा क्रमांक 87/2, रकबा 0.405 हेक्टेयर (लगभग 1.00 एकड़) है, जो विक्रेता को उनके पति स्व. श्री मोहनलाल यादव की मृत्यु के बाद नामांतरण से प्राप्त हुई थी।
उक्त भूमि का सौदा कुल प्रतिफल राशि ₹18,50,000/- (अक्षरी अठारह लाख पचास हज़ार रुपये मात्र) में तय हुआ, जिसका भुगतान क्रेता ने विक्रेता को इस प्रकार किया:
(1) ₹1,50,000/- नगद, दिनांक 02.05.2019 को बयाने के रूप में;
(2) ₹17,00,000/- चेक क्रमांक 004512 दिनांक 14.06.2019 द्वारा।
विक्रेता ने पूरी राशि प्राप्त होना स्वीकार किया है और अब कोई राशि लेना बाकी नहीं है।

विक्रय की गई भूमि की चतुर्सीमा:
पूर्व में - खसरा क्रमांक 87/3 (श्री सुरेश कुमार जोशी की भूमि)
पश्चिम में - शासकीय रास्ता (कच्चा)
उत्तर में - खसरा क्रमांक 86 (श्री बद्रीलाल पटेल की भूमि)
दक्षिण में - नाला
1. विक्रेता ने आज दिनांक को उक्त भूमि का वास्तविक कब्ज़ा मौके पर क्रेता को सौंप दिया है। आज से क्रेता उक्त भूमि का पूर्ण स्वामी होगा और राजस्व रिकॉर्ड में अपने नाम का नामांतरण करा सकेगा।
2. विक्रेता घोषणा करती है कि उक्त भूमि पूरी तरह भार-मुक्त है, उस पर कोई बैंक लोन, बंधक या कोर्ट केस नहीं है। आगे कोई विवाद निकलने पर उसकी ज़िम्मेदारी विक्रेता की होगी।
3. बाज़ार मूल्य (कलेक्टर गाइडलाइन अनुसार) ₹17,62,000/-; अदा किया गया स्टाम्प शुल्क ₹1,38,750/-; पंजीयन शुल्क ₹14,800/-।
गवाह: 1. श्री दिनेश चौधरी पिता श्री हरिराम चौधरी, ग्राम नवलखी खेड़ा   2. श्री महेश पाटीदार पिता श्री कन्हैयालाल पाटीदार, इंदौर
हस्ताक्षर विक्रेता (अंगूठा निशानी)          हस्ताक्षर क्रेता

pages:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH, BENCH AT INDORE
M.Cr.C. No. 31457/2026
Vikram Singh Thakur S/o Shri Bhanu Pratap Singh Thakur, aged about 34 years, Occupation: Property dealer, R/o 14, Shri Ganesh Colony, Ujjain (M.P.), presently confined in District Jail, Ujjain  ....APPLICANT
VERSUS
State of Madhya Pradesh through Police Station Amarpura, District Ujjain (M.P.)  ....RESPONDENT
FIRST BAIL APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 483 OF THE BHARATIYA NAGARIK SURAKSHA SANHITA, 2023
Crime No. 298/2026, Police Station Amarpura, District Ujjain, for offences under Sections 318(4), 316(2) and 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
The applicant above named respectfully submits as under:
1. That the applicant was arrested on 14.08.2026 in connection with the aforesaid crime and since then he is in custody.
2. That the bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned III Additional Sessions Judge, Ujjain by order dated 09.09.2026 passed in Bail Application No. 1876/2026.
3. That this is the first bail application of the applicant before this Hon'ble Court and no other bail application of the applicant is pending or has been decided by this Hon'ble Court.

GROUNDS
4. That the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated. The dispute, if any, is purely civil in nature, arising out of a transaction of Plot No. 27, Shiv Shakti Nagar Extension, Ujjain.
5. That the allegation of payment of Rs. 7,40,000/- is exaggerated. The applicant's firm M/s Thakur Properties received only Rs. 5,40,000/- through RTGS; no cash of Rs. 2,00,000/- was ever paid and the alleged bayana chitthi does not bear the applicant's signature. Out of this amount the applicant has already refunded Rs. 1,50,000/- to the complainant on 28.07.2026, i.e. before the FIR was lodged, which fact has been concealed.
6. That according to the complainant himself he came to know of the alleged registry on 25.07.2026, but the FIR was lodged only on 12.08.2026, after an unexplained delay of 18 days.
7. That the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is a respectable property dealer of Ujjain.
8. That the applicant is a permanent resident of Ujjain and the sole earning member of his family, which consists of his wife, two minor children and his mother aged 61 years.

9. That the investigation is almost complete, nothing remains to be recovered from the applicant, and the trial is likely to take a long time.
10. That the applicant undertakes to deposit Rs. 2,00,000/- before the trial court, to be disbursed to the complainant subject to the outcome of the trial, and to abide by any condition imposed by this Hon'ble Court.
PRAYER: It is therefore prayed that the applicant be released on bail during the pendency of the trial on furnishing a personal bond with surety to the satisfaction of the trial court.
Indore, dated 22.09.2026
Applicant, through counsel Ashutosh Verma, Advocate
AFFIDAVIT: I, Vikram Singh Thakur, state on oath that the contents of paras 1 to 10 of this application are true and correct to my knowledge. Sworn at Ujjain on 21.09.2026.

FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 173 B.N.S.S.)
[English translation of the original Hindi FIR - true translation]
1. District: Ujjain    P.S.: Amarpura    Year: 2026    FIR No.: 0298    Date: 12.08.2026
2. Acts and Sections: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 - 318(4), 316(2), 3(5)
3. (a) Occurrence of offence: from date 10.01.2026 to date 25.07.2026
   (b) Information received at P.S.: date 12.08.2026, time 17:40 hrs
   (c) General Diary reference: Entry No. 027, time 17:40 hrs
4. Type of information: Written
5. Place of occurrence: Office of Thakur Properties, Station Road, Ujjain; direction and distance from P.S.: East, about 2 km; Beat No. 3
6. Complainant / Informant: Manoj Kumar Rathore S/o Ramprasad Rathore, age 41 years, occupation kirana shop, address Ward No. 9, Amarpura, Ujjain
7. Details of known / suspected / unknown accused: (1) Vikram Singh Thakur S/o Bhanu Pratap Singh Thakur, R/o Shri Ganesh Colony, Ujjain (2) Rakesh Meena, address not known
8. Reasons for delay in reporting: complainant was trying to get his money back by talking to the accused.
9. Particulars of properties involved: cash Rs. 2,00,000/- and Rs. 5,40,000/- through RTGS
10. Total value of property: Rs. 7,40,000/-

11. Contents of the FIR (written report of the complainant):
Sir, I am resident of the above address and run a kirana shop. In the month of January 2026, Vikram Singh Thakur, who does the business of plots and land under the name Thakur Properties, and his man Rakesh Meena showed me Plot No. 27, Shiv Shakti Nagar Extension, Ujjain, size 30 x 50 feet, and the deal was settled for Rs. 9,00,000/-. On date 10.01.2026 I gave Rs. 2,00,000/- cash as bayana at their office, for which Vikram Singh gave me a bayana chitthi in his own handwriting. On 18.02.2026 I sent Rs. 5,40,000/- by RTGS into the account of Thakur Properties. In this way I have paid a total of Rs. 7,40,000/-. After that both of them kept putting off the registry on one pretext or another. On 25.07.2026 when I enquired at the Sub-Registrar office I came to know that the same plot had already been registered on 05.06.2026 in the name of one Smt. Sunita Verma. When I asked Vikram Singh for my money back he said 'jo karna hai kar lo' and threatened me. Till today not a single rupee has been returned to me. Rakesh Meena has not been seen since then. I have the bayana chitthi and the RTGS slip. Report is given, action be taken.
Sd/- Manoj Kumar Rathore
12. Action taken: Since the above report discloses offences under the sections mentioned at item 2, the case was registered and taken up for investigation. Investigation handed over to S.I. Pradeep Yadav.
13. FIR read over to the complainant, admitted to be correctly recorded, and a copy given to the complainant free of cost.
Signature of Officer in charge, P.S. Amarpura

documents.title: Status report of the State (case diary extract) dated 20.10.2026
pages:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH, BENCH AT INDORE
M.Cr.C. No. 31457/2026 - Vikram Singh Thakur vs. State of M.P.
STATUS REPORT ON BEHALF OF THE RESPONDENT / STATE (on the basis of the case diary of Crime No. 298/2026, P.S. Amarpura, District Ujjain)
1. The FIR was registered on 12.08.2026 on the written report of complainant Manoj Kumar Rathore for offences under Sections 318(4), 316(2) and 3(5) BNS.
2. The applicant Vikram Singh Thakur was arrested on 14.08.2026 at 11:30 hrs from his office at Thakur Properties, Station Road, Ujjain, and was produced before the JMFC, Ujjain on 15.08.2026, who remanded him to judicial custody. He is lodged in District Jail, Ujjain.
3. During investigation the bayana chitthi dated 10.01.2026 and the RTGS slip dated 18.02.2026 were seized from the complainant, and a certified copy of the registry of Plot No. 27 dated 05.06.2026 in favour of Smt. Sunita Verma was obtained from the Sub-Registrar office. An amount of Rs. 2,10,000/- lying in the bank account of M/s Thakur Properties has been frozen.
4. Co-accused Rakesh Meena is absconding. A reward of Rs. 5,000/- has been declared by the Superintendent of Police, Ujjain for information leading to his arrest.

5. After completion of investigation against the applicant, charge-sheet No. 211/2026 was filed on 06.10.2026 before the Court of JMFC, Ujjain. Investigation against co-accused Rakesh Meena is continuing.
6. In his statement recorded on 16.08.2026 the complainant has stated that he has not received any refund from the applicant.
7. Criminal record of the applicant:
   (i) Crime No. 88/2023, P.S. Madhavpuri, Ujjain, under Sections 420 and 406 IPC - charge-sheet filed, pending trial;
   (ii) Crime No. 15/2021, P.S. Amarpura, Ujjain, under Sections 294, 323 and 506 IPC - disposed of on compromise.
8. The State opposes the bail application on the ground that the applicant has criminal antecedents, and if released he may influence the witnesses and help the co-accused to remain absconding.
Dated 20.10.2026          Station House Officer, P.S. Amarpura, District Ujjain
